title: The FunnelKit Payment Gateway for Stripe WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Insecure Direct Object…
description: The FunnelKit Payment Gateway for Stripe WooCommerce plugin for WordPress contains an Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) vulnerability in all versions up to and including 1.15.0.2. This flaw allows unauthenticated attackers to access full billing personally identifiable information (PII) of any store order by enumerating sequential order IDs via the 'order-pay' query parameter. The vulnerability arises from missing validation on this user-controlled parameter, causing sensitive data to be exposed in a JavaScript object on the order-pay page regardless of WooCommerce's own order-key validation.
